messages.message: Wishing you all the best for whatever comes next. You really did achieve something — we're just still working out what it was.
messages.name: An admirer in Hartlepool

messages.message: Thank you for your service. Sincerely, if briefly.
messages.name: Margaret, SW1

messages.message: I'll always remember the bold pledges. Especially the ones you abandoned within six weeks.
messages.name: Daniel

messages.message: Good luck out there. I hear the private sector is much more forgiving.
messages.name: Anonymous

messages.message: We're so proud of everything you nearly did.
messages.name: Office of the Loyal Opposition

messages.message: Cheers Keir. Don't take it personally — we'd be saying this to any of them.
messages.name: A weary voter

messages.message: Best wishes for retirement. Or whatever this is going to be.
messages.name: Anonymous

messages.message: Will always remember the manifesto. Wish you had too.
messages.name: Pete, Brighton
